requirement: provision.sh: the iptables rules it adds/removes actually block/open the site's mail egress in the Linux kernel (rule bookkeeping is covered by the fake-iptables cases; the kernel behaviour is not)

oracle.invariant: the Docker/iptables fence between sites is enforced by the Linux kernel; it can only be proven on a Linux host with the privileges to inspect it

prerequisites: a Linux host with iptables and the privileges to run it
